== Introduction

From {sgw-te} 3.0 you can use the Admin REST API to provision persistent configuration changes.
This content introduces the <<put_db-,Create Database>> and <<post_db-_config,Configure Database>> endpoints for convenience -- see {rest-api-admin--xref--database-configuration} for a full description of the endpoints available.


NOTE: You can define 1 custom scope per database with up to 1000 custom collections.
If you do not specify a custom scope and collection, Sync Gateway saves any documents you create in the default scope and collection.

Database and user creation times increase with the number of collections you configure.
User creation initializes access control for all associated collections, while database creation initializes Sync Gateway indexes (`sg_prefixed`) for new collections.


[#lbl-create-db]
include::partial$static_restapi/admin/index.adoc[tags="put_db-",leveloffset=+1]

=== Example

.Create database
====
This example creates a new {sgw} database.

[{tabs}]
=====

Curl::
+
--

[source, bash]
----

curl --location --request PUT 'http://127.0.0.1:4985/traveldb/' \ // <.>
--header 'Authorization: Basic c3luY19nYXRld2F5OnBhc3N3b3Jk' \ // <.>
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data-raw '{
"bucket": "todo", // <.>
"index": {"num_replicas": 0}
}'

----

--

HTTP::
+
--
[source,http]
----
PUT /traveldb/ HTTP/1.1 // <.>
Host: 127.0.0.1:4985
Authorization: Basic c3luY19nYXRld2F5OnBhc3N3b3Jk // <.>
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 44

{
"bucket": "todo", // <.>
"index": {"num_replicas": 0}
}
----
--

=====

<.> Create a {sgw} database called `traveldb`
<.> Use Basic Authentication to authenticate against an existing Couchbase Server RBAC user
<.> Point to the Couchbase Server bucket called `todo`

====

[#lbl-configure-db]
include::partial$static_restapi/admin/index.adoc[tags="post_db-_config",leveloffset=+1]

=== Example

.Configure database
====
This example configures an existing {sgw} database.

[{tabs}]
=====

Curl::
+
--

[source, bash]
----

curl --location --request PUT 'http://127.0.0.1:4985/traveldb/_config/' \ // <.>
--header 'Authorization: Basic c3luY19nYXRld2F5OnBhc3N3b3Jk' \ // <.>
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data-raw '{
  "enable_shared_bucket_access": true,
  "import_docs": true
}' // <.>

----

--

HTTP::
+
--
[source,http]
----
PUT /traveldb/_config/ HTTP/1.1  // <.>
Host: 127.0.0.1:4985
Authorization: Basic c3luY19nYXRld2F5OnBhc3N3b3Jk  // <.>
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 120

{
"enable_shared_bucket_access": true,
"import_docs": true
} // <.>
----
--

=====

<.> Configure (`_config`) a {sgw} database called `traveldb`
<.> Use Basic Authentication to authenticate against an existing Couchbase Server RBAC user
<.> Toggle a couple of database properties

====
